jobs.title: Systems Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
The Systems Implementation Consultant is responsible for configuring the software and delivering high quality knowledge transfer services to clients allowing them to use Tyler software products efficiently and effectively to achieve daily operations. The incumbent consults and partners with clients to gain a comprehensive understanding of workflow, business/technical requirements and needs to ensure that the knowledge transfer addresses client’s needs. The Systems Implementation Consultant ensures that the transition to Tyler software is completed according to predetermined timelines and establishes a positive baseline for the new relationship between the client site and Tyler Technologies.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide professional services such as consultation, software readiness, and education to clients on Tyler software products. Design and conduct knowledge transfer sessions on site or through remote Teams sessions.
* Educate users on software functionality as well as on data entry, system administration, user security, and user permissions.
* Perform consultation/analysis of client business model to identify and document client requirements regarding Tyler products and functionality.
* Recommend options for new approaches in client work processes as appropriate to ensure efficient software solution for the client’s needs.
* Identify and document business/technical requirement specifications for specific software design/development, forms, reports, interfaces, process, configuration, and other relevant changes.
* Independently configure system modules and workflows based on approved client requirements, ensuring alignment with implementation best practices.
* Conduct data validation and conversion analysis, including field\-level reconciliation, exception handling, and coordination with clients on data correction activities.
* Develop and execute client\-specific test plans, validating configuration, integrations, and reporting outputs prior to go\-live.
* Troubleshoot technical and functional issues of moderate complexity, identifying root causes and collaborating with Support or Development on resolution paths.
* Create custom reports or customize existing reports to satisfy client requirements. Play an active role in troubleshooting client issues or work with the Support or Development departments to resolve.
* Keep up to date on administrative tasks such as documenting client issues, communicating agendas, submitting trip reports, timesheets, and weekly expense reports, and updating systems\-related client activity.
* May assist QA staff with product testing or modification testing as required.
* Notify management and appropriate organization/department of issues or unplanned events that could impact the effectiveness/schedule/budget of the implementation.
* Create both client\-facing and internal documentation such as "quick tips" and "how to” guides.
* Act as liaison between the client and company’s technical staff including conveying technical information so that non\-technical individuals can understand.
* May participate in the annual User Conference. Facilitate user group discussion on assigned module/topic.
* Analyze detailed error logs to diagnose and resolve technical issues of moderate complexity.
* Identify and troubleshoot data issues within SQL databases.
* Review and interpret report code for applied understanding of system behavior and outputs.
* Read, update, and analyze XML and HTML to support debugging and issue resolution.
* Investigate and resolve errors across SQL, XML, and HTML environments.
* Map and validate data conversions to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Conduct in\-depth data analysis to identify root causes of software issues.
* May travel extensively to client sites.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Scope and Impact**
The Systems Implementation Consultant position is a revenue\-generating position. The position is important for successful software implementation in alignment with client’s workflow, systems, processes, and other related needs. Incumbents in this position are accountable for identifying and resolving issues of moderate complexity, partnering with senior staff to resolve issues, and capturing the client’s specific software/business specifications, configuration, and other needs. The quality of the implementation can directly affect the volume of work and the project’s profitability. He or she adheres to project assignments but must use independent judgment and available resources to successfully transition the client to Tyler software. **Complexity**

* Demonstrate working technical proficiency with structured data, markup, and database querying concepts used in Tyler products.
* Independently apply technical skills to analyze, configure, troubleshoot, and validate system data and outputs.
* Use technical knowledge to support data analysis, conversions, integrations, reporting, and issue resolution of moderate complexity.
* Effectively communicate technical concepts to clients and internal teams at an appropriate level of detail.
* Expeditiously learn, understand, demonstrate, and educate clients on Tyler software applications by following the implementation methodology approach.
* Demonstrate ability to understand business processes and apply these to the product.
* Demonstrate excellent people skills and ability to build client relationships.
* Maintain a courteous, professional, and confident demeanor throughout the implementation process.
* Work with a diverse group of people and adapt to and work in a dynamic environment.
* Instill client confidence in the use of Tyler applications by providing effective one\-on\-one or group education.
* Exercise good judgment, discretion, and tact while working with clients.
* Maintain the ability to perform the functions of the application on different data platforms.
* Manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously across multiple projects.
* Be prepared to participate, recommend, and assist other team members.
* Complete tasks with minimal to general direction.
* Demonstrate proficient knowledge of implementation processes, problem management tools, and procedures.
* Demonstrate excellent partnering, communicating, and negotiating skills to gather client requirements and communicate effectively with the Project Managers, Development, DBAs, and Support staff.
* Maintain composure under pressure and accurately evaluate and resolve problem situations.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based, customer service\-oriented environment.
* Recognize and react appropriately to the complexity and criticality of incidents related to the implementation business function.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, or related discipline; or comparable related work experience.
* At least two years’ experience as an Associate Implementation Consultant or equivalent work\-related experience.
* Exceptional presentation and knowledge transfer skills.
* Tax and appraisal industry and/or product knowledge is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity and ease with computer systems and Microsoft Office products.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Demonstrated ability to read and interpret technical code, including report logic, XML, and HTML.
* Experience analyzing and debugging complex error log.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Experience with data mapping, data validation, and data conversion processes.
* Ability to translate technical findings into actionable insights.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross\-functionally.
* Ability to travel extensively.
* Valid driver’s license.

jobs.title: Contact Center Training Specialist (10.13 Start)
jobs.description:
**Contact Center Trainer (Service \& Sales)**
=============================================


**Remote • Full\-Time • Training \& Development**


**Why Join Grand Circle Corporation?**
--------------------------------------



At Grand Circle, our people aren't just part of the business, they *are* the business. We're a travel company powered by a people\-first culture where feedback is welcomed, new ideas are encouraged, and development never stops.



As a Contact Center Trainer, you'll help develop the associates who create unforgettable experiences for travelers around the world. You'll have the opportunity to shape onboarding, coaching, and development across our service and sales teams.


### **What Makes GCC Different?**


* A people\-first, feedback\-driven culture
* Real career growth across training, leadership, and operations
* The opportunity to shape and improve training programs
* A mission that means something: enriching lives through travel
* Travel perks that let you experience the journeys you help make possible


If you love developing people, improving training programs, and making an impact, we want to meet you.


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for an experienced **Contact Center Trainer** to join our Training team and support talent development across the Traveler Relations Center.



You'll facilitate engaging virtual training, lead new\-hire onboarding, and support ongoing coaching and development across both customer service and sales. You'll partner with leaders to identify skill gaps, improve training programs, and help associates reach their full potential.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Deliver engaging virtual training for new and existing contact center associates across service and sales, primarily through Microsoft Teams.
* Lead new\-hire onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning initiatives.
* Create and improve training materials including presentations, videos, job aids, assessments, and knowledge checks.
* Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, learner engagement, ramp time, and post\-training performance.
* Coach associates on systems, software, hardware, and contact center tools.
* Assess trainee performance, identify skill gaps, and provide targeted coaching.
* Use feedback, assessment results, and performance data to identify training opportunities and measure effectiveness.
* Partner with the Training Director and department leaders to align training with evolving business needs.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* **Training experience (required):** 2\+ years of experience as a trainer, facilitator, or learning professional.
* **Virtual training experience (required):** Experience facilitating live virtual training through Teams, Zoom, or similar platforms.
* **Contact center training experience (strongly preferred):** Experience leading new\-hire or cohort\-based training in a contact center, customer service, or sales environment.
* **Curriculum development (required):** Experience creating, adapting, and improving training content and materials.
* **Innovative mindset (required):** Continuously looks for ways to improve training, onboarding, and learner outcomes.
* **Tech savvy (required):** Comfortable learning new systems and troubleshooting technical issues.
* **Adaptable (required):** Able to remain calm and effective when priorities or processes change.
* **Feedback\-driven (required):** Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback in a collaborative environment.
* **People\-first (required):** Patient, approachable, and able to adapt to different learning styles and skill levels.
* **Sales training or contact center sales experience (strongly preferred).**
* **Travel industry experience (preferred).**
* **GDS experience (preferred):** Familiarity with Sabre, Apollo, Amadeus, or Worldspan is a plus.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**
----------------------------------------------



The most successful candidates will:


* Bring new ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.
* Build trust and credibility with learners and leaders.
* Use technology, creativity, and data to create effective learning experiences.
* Balance learner needs with operational and business goals.
* Embrace feedback and continuously look for ways to improve.


Equal Opportunity Employer  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Hybrid/Remote Position; must be in one of the following markets: West Palm Beach, Broward County, Boca Raton or Boynton Beach\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

Senior Implementation Project Specialist**About your role:**


As a Senior Implementation Project Specialist, you will lead implementation activities for new and existing clients, helping ensure solutions are delivered on time and aligned to client requirements. You will work closely with clients and cross\-functional internal teams to coordinate project execution, maintain implementation standards, and support scalable, well\-documented delivery processes that contribute to successful client outcomes.

* Maintain implementation documentation, procedures, and project audit records related to new products, features, and client\-specific requirements.
* Support issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and after\-hours implementation activities when needed.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 5\+ years of experience in project coordination, implementation, or project management supporting client delivery, installation, or solution rollout activities.
* 4\+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent projects, timelines, and stakeholder communications in a client\-facing environment.
* Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to create project documentation, status reporting, and implementation materials.
* Experience documenting implementation procedures, tracking deliverables, and supporting issue resolution across cross\-functional teams.
* High school diploma, General Educational Development (GED), associate degree, or higher, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience supporting electronic funds transfer (EFT), ATM, or financial services implementations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience working with proprietary configuration tools, client setup workflows, or operational readiness processes.

**How you'll work:**

* This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

**Sponsorship:**


You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F\-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H\-1B, H\-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

**Benefits at Fiserv:**

* Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well\-being.
* Paid holidays and generous time away policies.
* No\-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.
* Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards.
* Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network.
* Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities.
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one.
* Retirement planning including 401k match and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
* Tuition assistance and reimbursement program.
* Paid parental and military leave.


This role is not eligible to be performed in Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Nevada, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Maine or Washington.

**Note to agencies:**


Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist (Remote)**
======================================


**Build the System That Launches an Industry**
----------------------------------------------


Nest Veterinary is on track to 5X this year. We're the category leader in care plan infrastructure for veterinary practices — and every new hospital that joins our network goes live because of the work our Implementation team does. If you love building processes, owning outcomes, and making complex launches look effortless, this role was made for you.

**About Nest Veterinary**


Our mission is simple: make pet care accessible to every pet parent. We provide fully\-managed, tech\-enabled care plan solutions that help veterinary practices increase compliance, drive revenue, and deliver better preventive care — without the administrative burden.


We're transforming an industry, and we're doing it with design\-forward products and a team that genuinely cares about the outcome.

**The Role**
------------


As an Implementation Specialist, you're the engine behind every successful hospital launch. You'll orchestrate the onboarding process from kickoff to go\-live — coordinating logistics, validating readiness, and ensuring every technical and operational detail is locked in before launch day.


But this role goes beyond project management. You'll also be a key trainer and coach for the practices you onboard, preparing hospital teams to confidently integrate care plans into their daily offerings. You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Hospital Success Managers to make sure practices don't just go live — they go live ready.


At Nest, implementation isn't a back\-office function. It's one of the most visible, high\-impact roles in the company.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Leadership**


Own the launch. You'll serve as project lead for new hospital onboarding — driving timelines, managing deliverables, and co\-leading rollouts alongside Hospital Success Managers to ensure a seamless, coordinated experience for every practice.

### **Practice Training \& Readiness**


Prepare hospital teams to succeed with care plans from day one. You'll deliver training sessions that equip veterinary staff with the knowledge, confidence, and workflows they need to successfully introduce care plans as part of their practice offerings — making the transition feel natural, not disruptive.

### **Logistics \& Readiness Coordination**


Execute the behind\-the\-scenes work that makes launches run smoothly. You'll manage scheduling, resource allocation, and communication flow; confirm all readiness checkpoints before go\-live; and align internal teams, vendors, and hospital staff so nothing falls through the cracks.

### **Technical Review \& Validation**


Be the checkpoint owner. You'll conduct readiness reviews to verify integrations, configurations, and systems are launch\-ready; coordinate with Engineering, clients, and Support on any outstanding requirements; and document all technical and logistical sign\-offs for a clean handoff.

### **Cross\-Team Collaboration**


Your work doesn't end at launch. You'll partner with Hospital Success Managers throughout the onboarding lifecycle, support a smooth transition to the ongoing support team, and bring post\-launch insights back to Product, Engineering, and Hospital Success to continuously improve the process.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years in SaaS implementation, operations, or project management (veterinary or healthcare experience is a plus)
* Experience training or enabling client\-facing teams — you know how to make complex concepts click
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate logistics across multiple stakeholders and keep projects on track
* Epic organizational skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in fast\-moving environments
* Excellent communicator — clear and confident with both internal teams and hospital staff
* Familiarity with veterinary practice workflows or healthcare systems is a plus
* Startup experience preferred — you're comfortable building as you go and raising your hand when something could be better
* Familiarity with CRM Database workflows

**Why Nest**
------------

* 5X growth trajectory — your work will directly shape how we scale
* High visibility role — every hospital launch has your fingerprints on it
* Mission that matters — more pets getting the preventive care they need because practices are set up to succeed
* Ground\-floor opportunity — help define what great implementation looks like at a category\-leading company
* Teammates who show up — kind, motivated, and genuinely collaborative

*Nest is an equal\-opportunity employer. You are welcome at Nest for who you are, no matter where you come from or what you look like. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. Bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It's in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing veterinary health care and help pets live longer, healthier, and happier lives.*

  

Compensation Range: $75K \- $80K
